howItWorks.title: How Strovak works for you
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps and your stream goes multilingual — no plugin for your viewers.

steps.title: Install & pair the app
steps.body: Grab the desktop app and punch in your code. It only takes your mic audio — your video and gameplay never leave your PC.

steps.title: Pick where the translation shows up
steps.body: Baked into your OBS scene, native captions viewers switch on, or a separate dubbed channel — you choose per platform.

steps.title: Go live like you always do
steps.body: Stream to Twitch, Kick or YouTube as usual. Your non-English viewers follow you live, in their own language.

howItWorks.note: That's it — no extra plugin for your viewers, and no re-streaming your gameplay to the cloud.

hero.title: Your video never leaves your PC.
hero.summary: Strovak processes only your microphone audio in the cloud — a small encrypted stream of roughly 50–128 Kbps. Your gameplay, camera, and scene stay on your machine, always.

claims.title: Video stays local
claims.body: The desktop app captures only speech audio. Video is encoded and delivered by OBS from your PC — it is never uploaded to Strovak.

claims.title: Encrypted in transit
claims.body: Every connection — app, dashboard, and audio stream — runs over TLS 1.3, with mutual authentication between the app and the cloud.

claims.title: Encrypted at rest
claims.body: Stored data, stream keys, and future voice profiles are protected with AES-256. Secrets live in a managed vault, never in code.

claims.title: You own your data
claims.body: Delete your account and your data — including any voice profile — is permanently removed, in line with GDPR and KVKK.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.subtitle: Provider API keys entered here go live immediately, without a restart. Values are always masked: only the start and end are readable.

errors.unauthorized: Your admin session is missing or expired. Sign in again to manage secrets.
errors.network: Could not reach the API. Check NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL and that the backend is running.
errors.saveFailed: Save failed. The value may be empty or the name is not managed.

secrets.maskNote: Values are masked server-side: the API returns only the first and last characters of each secret (for example sk_l...3456). The full value never leaves the server.
secrets.note: Keys resolve at call time, so a key saved here activates its provider on the next request. In production set providers.mock_fallback to false under Service routing so missing keys fail loudly instead of producing mock output.
